headline: Recent Graduate Successfully Navigates Job Market By Registering As 'Architectural Landmark' To Qualify For Maintenance Grants
body:
Aditya Sharma, 23, who has spent the last fourteen months applying to entry-level analyst roles without a single callback, officially transitioned his career path this morning after the local municipal corporation classified his studio apartment as a 'Heritage Site of Unemployment.' By donning a small brass plaque and refusing to move from his armchair, Sharma has managed to secure a monthly government preservation stipend meant for the upkeep of historic structures that are no longer functional.

'The job market was too competitive, but the historical preservation sector is booming,' said Sharma, while dusting off a stack of rejection emails that he now keeps behind a velvet rope. 'I realized that if I couldn't be a valuable asset to a corporation, I could at least be a piece of cultural history that the government is legally obligated to protect from further decay.'

His primary responsibility now involves sitting perfectly still for eight hours a day so that passersby can photograph him as a representative example of the 'Generation of Infinite Wait-Times.' Local heritage officials have already praised his performance, noting that his stoic expression and collection of unread entry-level cover letters provide a poignant, authentic look at the current economic landscape that a museum could never replicate.

While his former classmates are still oscillating between unpaid internships and soul-crushing interview rounds, Sharma has already expanded his operation by petitioning for the installation of a small, informational audio guide in his hallway. The guide will allow visitors to hear a looped recording of his voice explaining exactly why his degree in marketing is currently worth less than the cost of the laminate on his diploma.
caption: Forget job boards, this guy found the ultimate loophole to stay productive. Is this the future of the Indian career path? 🏛️📈 #CareerHacks #JobSearch #HeritageStatus #LifeSkills (satire)
igHook: Would you rather work a 9-to-5 or be declared a protected national monument?
imagePrompt: A wide-angle, slightly out-of-focus shot of a young man sitting motionless on a minimalist sofa in a sparsely furnished, sunlit room, with a small professional-looking brass plaque mounted on the wall beside him.

sourceHeadline.title: What Happens When Millions Of Young Indians Can't Find Their First Job?

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 5 is the most original; while many candidates rely on the 'unemployed person starts a business' trope, this one uses the absurdist bureaucratic angle of being declared a 'Heritage Site' to get a government grant, which is a perfect satire of both the job market and government inertia.

safetyVerdict.reasoning: The piece uses a fictional character to provide social commentary on the job market and is clearly satirical. It does not name a real private person, public figure, or target any protected group, and the image prompt is generic.
